mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (id, room_id, sender, message, time) VALUES (chat_seq.NEXTVAL, #{roomId}, #{sender}, #{message}, #{time})
mapper.select: SELECT room_id, sender, message, time FROM chat_message WHERE room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT * FROM CHAT_ROOM WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND ((SELLER_NO = #{senderUserNo} AND BUYER_NO = #{receiverUserNo}) OR (SELLER_NO = #{receiverUserNo} AND BUYER_NO = #{senderUserNo}))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_ROOM (ROOM_ID, PRODUCT_ID, SELLER_NO, BUYER_NO, CREATED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_CHAT_ROOM.NEXTVAL, #{productId}, #{senderUserNo}, #{receiverUserNo}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT R.ROOM_ID, R.PRODUCT_ID, R.SELLER_NO, R.BUYER_NO, R.CREATED_AT, CASE WHEN R.SELLER_NO = #{userNo} THEN R.BUYER_NO ELSE R.SELLER_NO END AS OTHER_USER_NO, (SELECT M.MESSAGE FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID AND M.MSG_ID = (SELECT MAX(MSG_ID) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID) ) AS LAST_MESSAGE, (SELECT M.SENT_AT FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID AND M.MSG_ID = (SELECT MAX(MSG_ID) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID) ) AS LAST_MESSAGE_TIME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID AND M.SENDER_NO != #{userNo} AND M.IS_READ = 'N' ) AS UNREAD_COUNT FROM CHAT_ROOM R WHERE R.SELLER_NO = #{userNo} OR R.BUYER_NO = #{userNo} ORDER BY CASE WHEN (SELECT MAX(M.SENT_AT) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID) IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT MAX(M.SENT_AT) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID) ELSE R.CREATED_AT END DESC
SELECT M.ROOM_ID, M.SENDER_NO, U.NAME AS SENDER_NAME, M.MESSAGE, M.SENT_AT FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M JOIN USERS_TB U ON M.SENDER_NO = U.USER_NO WHERE M.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY M.SENT_AT
mapper.update: UPDATE CHAT_MESSAGE SET IS_READ = 'Y' WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND IS_READ = 'N' AND SENDER_NO = #{targetUserNo}
mapper.select: SELECT U.NAME, M.SENT_AT FROM USERS_TB U JOIN CHAT_MESSAGE M ON U.USER_NO = M.SENDER_NO WHERE M.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY SENT_AT DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT R.ROOM_ID, R.PRODUCT_ID, R.SELLER_NO, R.BUYER_NO, CASE WHEN R.SELLER_NO = #{userNo} THEN R.BUYER_NO ELSE R.SELLER_NO END AS OTHER_USER_NO, ( SELECT MESSAGE FROM ( SELECT M.MESSAGE FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID ORDER BY M.MSG_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 ) AS LAST_MESSAGE, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M WHERE M.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID AND M.SENDER_NO != #{userNo} AND M.IS_READ = 'N' ) AS UNREAD_COUNT FROM CHAT_ROOM R WHERE R.ROOM_ID = #{roomId}
